parameters.formula: 0.2204 * max(0, slope_pct - 15) * system_factor
parameters.source: Interior Appraisal Manual, effective 2026-07-01 (2026)
parameters.licence: BC Crown copyright; public PDF.
parameters.notes: IAM 2026 EWB SLOPE15 coefficient; a bid-response proxy, not an observed cost.

parameters.formula: -9.321 * ln(piece_size_m3 / 0.60) * system_factor
parameters.source: Interior Appraisal Manual, effective 2026-07-01 (2026)
parameters.licence: BC Crown copyright; public PDF.
parameters.notes: IAM 2026 EWB ln(VPT) coefficient; smaller trees increase cost.

parameters.formula: clamp(-4.306 * ln(sale_volume_m3 / 20000), -6, +6) * system_factor
parameters.applicability: all systems; heli factor 0.5; cap +/-6 CAD/m3
parameters.source: Interior Appraisal Manual, effective 2026-07-01 (2026)
parameters.licence: BC Crown copyright; public PDF.
parameters.notes: IAM 2026 EWB ln(VOL/1000) coefficient used as a fixed-cost spreading proxy.

parameters.formula: 2.407 * CYCLE * CPIF
parameters.source: Interior Appraisal Manual, effective 2026-07-01 (2026)
parameters.licence: BC Crown copyright; public PDF.
parameters.notes: IAM 2026 section 3.4 transportation route equation. CYCLE includes loading, hauling, weighing, unloading, return and unavoidable delays.

parameters.formula: 1 km loaded at 10 km/h + 1 km empty at 15 km/h
parameters.source: Interior Appraisal Manual, effective 2026-07-01 (2026)
parameters.licence: BC Crown copyright; public PDF.

parameters.formula: road distance loaded/empty speed
parameters.source: Interior Appraisal Manual, effective 2026-07-01 (2026)
parameters.licence: BC Crown copyright; public PDF.
parameters.notes: IAM requires district cycle-time schedules but they are not public; 55/65 km/h is a transparent all-weather road proxy.

parameters.formula: 78 min unavoidable delay + 0.5 h loading/unloading
parameters.source: Interior Appraisal Manual, effective 2026-07-01 (2026)
parameters.licence: BC Crown copyright; public PDF.
parameters.notes: 78 min is IAM 2026 section 3.2.12.1(5). The 0.5 h load/unload is an engineering proxy because district schedules are not public.

parameters.formula: payload m3 per trip
parameters.source: 9-axle B-trains for log hauling on BC resource roads (2021)
parameters.licence: Public report; publisher copyright.
parameters.notes: FPInnovations 2021 reports 43-50 t payload by configuration; at green-wood density ~0.85 t/m3 this is ~50-59 m3. 50 m3 is a conservative central value.

parameters.source: Interior Appraisal Manual, effective 2026-07-01 (2026)
parameters.licence: BC Crown copyright; public PDF.
parameters.notes: IAM 2026 helicopter specified-operation allowance used as a total logging proxy. The FPInnovations 2002 case study (77.27 CAD/m3) supports the order of magnitude.

parameters.formula: low scenario x 1.20 productivity; high scenario x 0.75 productivity
parameters.source: Roadside harvesting with low ground-pressure skidders in northwestern British Columbia (2001)
parameters.licence: Public FPInnovations Advantage report; publisher copyright.
parameters.notes: Bounded by the spread between published PMH and SMH productivities and across case studies. Not a statistical confidence interval.

limitations: All-found equipment rates are contractor revenue requirements, not observed costs.
Productivity is transferred from public case studies and is not a BC-wide survey.
The rate guide publishes two region groups, not seven forest zones.
North West Zone is appraisal-Interior but uses the coastal/northwest machine-rate group.
Slope, piece-size and sale-volume coefficients are IAM bid-response proxies, not cost elasticities.
Coastal barge/tow, rail, sorting and road/silviculture costs are outside this model.
The helicopter allowance is a specified-operation proxy, not an observed heli contract rate.
No ILCR/CCTMCS microdata, FPInterface, or confidential mill settlement was used.
